name: prove
description: Run the configured proof producers and ingest valid kibi.proof-run.v1 evidence

options.description: Prove a single test entity
Prove every proof-bearing test behind a requirement
Prove only tests bound to these integrations (comma-separated)
With --all (or another selector), skip tests bound to these integrations (comma-separated)
Prove every proof-bearing test in the knowledge base
Prove only the selected tests (all by default) without a current passing receipt
Skip integrations an interrupted run with the same selector already ingested at this snapshot

name: proof
description: Inspect proof integration and maintain proof evidence

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Detect test infrastructure, propose a proof integration and return the reviewed plan that writes .kb/proof/integrations.json

options.description: Plan adding or replacing this integration in an existing .kb/proof/integrations.json
Command the proposed integration runs instead of the detected one: space-separated words, or a JSON array of argv strings (e.g. '["npx","vitest","run","tests/e2e"]')
Emit structured JSON

commands.name: run-steps
commands.description: Run the declared steps of the proof-bearing tests kibi prove selected and write a per-test report, so a command integration fails only the tests whose own steps failed (use as the integration's command)

options.description: Run these tests' steps (default: KIBI_PROOF_TEST_IDS, else every test in the file)

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Project one requirement or symbol proof, labeling required_proofs, executable_for, and covered_by separately

options.description: Explain a requirement ID
Explain a symbol ID
Emit structured JSON

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Shrink each test's proof_receipts history to its newest entries (re-proving the same snapshot appends duplicates; prune removes the superseded ones)

options.description: Prune a single test entity
Number of newest receipts to keep per test (default 1)

commands.name: compact
commands.description: Drop superseded proof receipts while keeping every receipt that decides current proof (newest per scope and contract for the live snapshot and current binding, plus the newest and newest passing receipt); coverage results are unchanged

options.description: Compact a single test entity
Report what would be removed without writing
Emit structured JSON

commands.name: migrate-legacy
commands.description: Remove legacy verification_receipts blocks from test documents that already carry a proof_contract

options.description: Migrate a single test entity
